provenance.note: intended_tier is the SATS category each vignette was constructed to exercise, assigned by a single non-clinician author. It is a specification-conformance answer key, not a clinician's reference standard. Because there is no clinician label and no second labeler, agreement against it measures whether the rules realise their design intent — not clinical validity — and inter-rater reliability is not computed. Replace intended_tier with reviewed clinician labels (and set second_labeler_id) to produce the tool-vs-clinician kappa the paper's title promises.
